result.title: Leap-VLA: High-Rate Robot Control from a Low-Rate VLM Backbone
result.comment: 21 pages, 14 figures. Corresponding author: Lin Yang
result.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models re-encode the full observation through a multi-billion-parameter vision-language model (VLM) at every control step, even though scene semantics evolve at roughly 1 Hz while reactive control requires 20-50 Hz. We present a VLA that decouples the two: a VLM runs as a low-frequency semantic anchor whose cached context is reused across control steps, while a flow-matching action expert operates at high frequency, consuming the cached semantics with a fresh, low-latency visual stream from a compact encoder pretrained on robot video with masked reconstruction, optical flow, and depth. The measured age $τ$ of the cache conditions the expert through adaptive layer normalization. Reusing the cache makes the policy a function of its age, and training covers that function explicitly: cache ages sampled from real episode history, plus an age-ramped pixel corruption that erases the stale snapshot the way deployed staleness corrupts content. On the asynchronous deployment stack, the recipe closes most of the staleness gap: on LIBERO-Spatial, 61.4% to 95.5% at a 2 s semantic refresh (95.9% at 1 s, within 1.6 points of the frequency-matched anchor); averaged over the four LIBERO suites, the deployed policy holds 95.2% at a 1 s refresh and 94.5% at 2 s against a 96.3% matched anchor. A forward-only chunk-boundary correction (soft-nudge), an autograd-free reformulation of real-time-chunking guidance, carries per-control-step re-planning without loss (97.1%) at zero added latency. The same lens exposes a second defect: under an instruction-scene mismatch the policy keeps manipulating the scene, and a chain-of-thought verdict gate trained on zero-cost negative episodes freezes execution exactly on mismatched instructions without hurting feasible success.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Leap-VLA：低频 VLM 作为语义锚点并复用其缓存上下文，高频 flow-matching 动作专家配合紧凑编码器的新鲜视觉流，用缓存年龄 τ 通过自适应 layerNorm 调节专家，并以真实历史年龄采样加年龄递增的像素损坏进行训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把「缓存/潜状态年龄」显式作为策略输入并训练陈旧状态下的行为，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态刷新间隔、陈旧证据与 THINK/LOOK 成本权衡提供可供核查的建模线索；但目标为机器人高频控制，与视觉推理任务差距较大。
